headlines.title: Voters making final decisions in midterm elections
headlines.description: Voters across the U.S. are making their choices in the midterm elections as those competing for their vote make their final pitches.

headlines.title: How the Michigan and Alaska dramas shape the fight for the Senate: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur explains how a pair of controversies in Michigan and Alaska could impact the broader battle for Senate control.

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Co-pilot and passengers killed in learjet crash identified
headlines.description: A family on a trip to the Bahamas and a 20-year-old pilot are among the nine people killed when a Learjet crashed in Florida over the weekend. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports from the scene of the crash.

headlines.title: New York reports first measles death in more than 30 years
headlines.description: So far this year, the state has reported 178 measles cases.

headlines.title: Study links energy drinks to risk of cardiac arrest
headlines.description: New research presented at the American Heart Association’s annual meeting found that cardiac arrest was higher among those who consumed energy drinks and supplements. NBC News’ Berkeley Lovelace Jr. explains which types of stimulants to watch out for.

headlines.title: With AO3 down, fanfic readers are in survival mode
headlines.description: When the internet’s biggest fanfiction repository vanishes from reach, there’s one thing you can still count on: a network of fellow fans.

headlines.title: Democrats in key battlegrounds throw Joe Biden under the bus on the border
headlines.description: Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability.

headlines.title: ‘Looks like Mars’: Toxic smog from Indonesia wildfires sparks health crisis, protests
headlines.description: Wildfires in Indonesia are blanketing the country and other southeast Asian nations in toxic smog, prompting widespread protests.

headlines.title: Affording America: For a traveling carnival, rising costs mean a bumpy ride
headlines.description: Blake Huston is a third generation carnival operator who has been around the business all his life. But rising gas, labor and insurance costs are all taking a toll on his bottom line and threatening the industry he calls a way of life.

headlines.title: 17-year-old arrested in Spirit Halloween shooting that killed pregnant woman, injured 6 other people
headlines.description: The attack took place Friday as shoppers at the store in the San Francisco Bay Area city of Fairfield prepared for Halloween.

headlines.title: Indicted ICE officer had been on the job a little over a year as Trump’s hiring surge comes under scrutiny
headlines.description: Mario Alberto Morales was released on bond following his indictment on a charge of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon.
